			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 226 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_consumer_contract value = 226 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_resource_credit value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_resource_maintenance_capacity value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_type_code value = 226 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 226 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_consumer_contract value = 226 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7226 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m226_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 226 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m226_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_credit_check value = { value = var:zg361_ip_m226_contributor_credit add = var:zg361_ip_m226_maintainer_credit } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_fork_policy_used value = var:zg361_ip_m225_upstream_first }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_consumer_settle_inner_source value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m226_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}

			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_z_revision

			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_z_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_z_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_z_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m228_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m228_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m228_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m228_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m228_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m228_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m228_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 228
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m228_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m228_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m228_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_platform_liability value = 60 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_user_liability value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_policy_liability value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_total_loss value = 100 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_local_degrade value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m228_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_platform_liability value = 20 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_user_liability value = 70 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_policy_liability value = 10 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_total_loss value = 100 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_local_degrade value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_type_code value = 228 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_blast_radius_liability value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 228 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_consumer_contract value = 228 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_resource_liability value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_resource_loss value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_type_code value = 228 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 228 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_consumer_contract value = 228 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7228 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m228_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_z_last_consumer value = 228 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m228_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_liability_check value = { value = var:zg361_ip_m228_platform_liability add = var:zg361_ip_m228_user_liability add = var:zg361_ip_m228_policy_liability } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_role_ledger_used value = var:zg361_ip_m227_credit_check }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_consumer_allocate_blast_liability value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m228_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
